{{Quote|All right, Bodwae, what the blinking mradhe muck is going on with those shields?|Booster Terrik|<ref name="Specter of the Past" />}}
A '''Mradhe''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of creature which created muck. The [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Akris Ur'etu]]<ref name="Reputation">{{InsiderCite|136|Reputation (Cad Bane)}}</ref> and the [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Booster Terrik]] both used "mradhe muck" as an expletive while dealing with subordinates.<ref name="Specter of the Past">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Mradhes were first mentioned in the [[1997]] novel ''[[Specter of the Past]]'' written by [[Timothy Zahn]].
